business_problem: Ryvu Therapeutics needed to explore a much broader chemical space and run large molecular dynamics campaigns without the manual scheduling, on-premises storage planning, and compute bottlenecks that slowed discovery.
solution_summary: Ryvu Therapeutics uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: Ryvu Therapeutics needed to explore a much broader chemical space and run large molecular dynamics campaigns without the manual scheduling, on-premises storage planning, and compute bottlenecks that slowed discovery. Google Batch acts as the backend for the automated in silico evaluation pipeline so hundreds of GPU simulations can launch in parallel, serving as the orchestration layer. Compute Engine provides the GPU capacity for large-scale molecular dynamics simulations and overnight campaign execution, serving as the compute layer. Google Cloud Storage stores and caches the terabytes of raw trajectory files produced by the simulation workflow, serving as the storage layer.
